subject: multiply a defined parameter by a constant inside the model in lavaan

messages.author: 649d11b722428382
messages.subject: multiply a defined parameter by a constant inside the model in lavaan
parts:
Dear All,

I'm trying to multiply my defined parameter `d_av` by a constant (`ct`) computed outside the model syntax without success. Is there a fix?

library("lavaan")

lower <- '10
          8 12'
( Cov <- getCov(lower, diag=TRUE, names=c("x_pre","x_post")) )

Mean <- c(10, 13)

N <- 50

ct <- .98  # How to multiply this by 'd_av' in the model?

model1 <- '# Label the sds with sd1 and sd2
           eta_pre =~ sd1*x_pre
           eta_post =~ sd2*x_post
           # Fix the error variances at 0
           x_pre ~~ 0*x_pre
           x_post ~~ 0*x_post
           # Label the means with m1 and m2
           x_pre ~ m1*1
           x_post ~ m2*1
           # Define d_av
           d_av := ((m2-m1)/(sd1)) * ct'

## Fit the model
fit1 <- cfa(model1, sample.cov=Cov, sample.mean=Mean,
            sample.nobs=N, std.lv=TRUE,
            sample.cov.rescale=FALSE)

messages.subject: Re: multiply a defined parameter by a constant inside the model in lavaan
parts: I'm trying to multiply my defined parameter `d_av` by a constant (`ct`) computed outside the model syntax without success. Is there a fix?

You can use paste() to add the actual value to the end of your script:

model1 <- paste('# Label the sds with sd1 and sd2

eta_pre =~ sd1*x_pre
           eta_post =~ sd2*x_post
           # Fix the error variances at 0
           x_pre ~~ 0*x_pre
           x_post ~~ 0*x_post
           # Label the means with m1 and m2
           x_pre ~ m1*1
           x_post ~ m2*1
           # Define d_av

d_av := ((m2-m1)/(sd1)) *', ct)
